B.S. Computer Science & B.S. Mathematics, expected May 2027
I’m a Computer Science and Mathematics double major at the University of West Florida, working at the intersection of cybersecurity analytics, applied statistics, and machine learning. My research so far has spanned network attack traffic analysis, incremental frequent pattern mining, and LLM-driven approaches to mass spectrometry data.

Research
Research Intern — National MagLab REU Program, Florida State University Summer 2026 · Mentor: David Butcher

Studied LLM-driven analysis of mass spectrometry peptide sequences, focused on LLM integration for ion cyclotron resonance (ICR) data
Ran a comparative study of Bayesian Optimization frameworks (DeepSCP, LLAMBO, BOPrO, GPTuner) for tuning Casanovo de novo peptide sequencing hyperparameters
Built Python client-server tooling to submit spectrometry data to each framework and benchmark predicted sequences against ground truth

Research Assistant — Data Analytics & Cybersecurity, University of West Florida January 2025 – Present

Analyze network traffic and security datasets to surface anomalous and high-risk behavior
Automate incremental data analysis pipelines in Python, improving reproducibility and cutting manual preprocessing time
Validate analytical results for accuracy and consistency across evolving datasets

Statistical Analyst — Statistics for Data Science, University of West Florida January 2025 – August 2025

Exploratory data analysis and regression modeling on real-world datasets
Cleaned, preprocessed, and validated structured data prior to analysis
Built dashboards, visualizations, and written reports in R and RMarkdown
